scope: Typed exact read-only inventory/navigation projection in disposable Dolt integration realms; no authenticated release, knowledge truth, citation lineage, writer or agent service

pin_contract.legacy_policy: StoragePin::LegacyDolt and its wire namespace remain unchanged and inspection-only; no casts or aliases
pin_contract.authority: Structural identity only; not a signed release or permission

physical_contracts.identity_rule: SHA-256 of exact compiled UTF-8 material, including newlines; fixture producer independently hashes printed material from the retained real executable
physical_contracts.null_projection: Native IS NULL is a strict JSON boolean; COALESCE payload is empty for null, while false with an empty string remains Some(empty)
physical_contracts.ordering: Strict binary UTF-8 ID order; duplicate/out-of-order rows refuse rather than normalize
physical_contracts.closure: Every edge source and target must occur in the same pinned node projection

ownership.roots: Existing descriptor-contained owner-only DB, HOME and coordination directories
ownership.lock: Preprovisioned singly-linked coordination/database.lock; existing-only exclusive flock for the entire query group; absence/replacement refuses
ownership.retention_root: wf-retained/<exact native commit>; checked before and after the read group
ownership.native_profile: Stopped/exclusive CLI only, no sql-server discovery, no inherited credentials/global profile, no saved/arbitrary SQL, no automatic GC
ownership.processes: Shared ProcessSupervisor owns groups; reserved leader PID, group kill, drained pipes, adopted descendants reaped before leader; no resource release before cleanup
ownership.budgets: Explicit bytes/rows plus one total read deadline and cancellation; overflow or partial/failed query yields no complete snapshot

production_mapping.models: V15 and M01/M03/M11 exact pins, reader ownership and retention assumptions; mappings only, no automatic production/model refinement or full obligation pass

required_campaign_families: actual complete old/current node and edge snapshots after native advancement
null versus empty, Unicode/CRLF and injection-shaped text
complete pin and actual tool/metadata identity mismatch refusal
missing or moved retention root with restored positive control
empty graph versus invalid scalar/metadata and dangling relationship refusal
busy/missing/replaced lock and contained path/server/global-profile refusal
owned child and descendant cleanup including existing Git callers
source-bound actual-body proof and meaningful commit/producer guard mutations
trusted_limits: Qualified native Dolt internals, hash properties, compiler, Linux local filesystem/procfs and cooperating administratively controlled metadata remain assumptions.
No hostile same-user sandbox, arbitrary source authenticity, concurrent external native writer, live SQL server or power-loss guarantee.
Current grants, completed Git publication, authenticated retention closure and production corpus methods remain DINT02/DINT03 responsibilities.
DINT01 and Splicery offline preview do not enable worktree effects or constitute a complete toolchain/benchmark result.
